svg.title: Discount engine architecture
svg.desc: Rules and cart CSV files are parsed and validated in the browser. A plain-language instruction is sent by the browser API client to the app's own /api/parse-rule server endpoint, which calls Groq (openai/gpt-oss-20b) with the text only, then grounds and validates the candidate rule. The user previews it and must confirm it before it joins the active rules. priceCart applies item-level and cart-level discounts and the app shows a results table and cart summary.

text.font-family: Spectral, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
Raleway, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: How CSV rules, plain-language offers and a cart become final prices. The dashed boundary represents the server-side API; Groq is an external inference service.
